bias.zh: 看空 · 跌回 $58.3 下方，仍在 5 日均线上方

read.en: Intel fell 2.1% on Nov 10 to $58.13, trading $56.85–60.65 on light volume (0.67x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($56.86) and below the 10-day ($65.82), 30-day ($89.74), 100-day ($100.38) and 200-day ($87.19); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($81.57), and RSI is 29.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月10日下跌 2.1%，收于 $58.13，盘中区间 $56.85–60.65，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.67 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$56.86）均线上方，10 日（$65.82）、30 日（$89.74）、100 日（$100.38）和 200 日（$87.19）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$81.57），RSI 为 29。

read.en: The close slipped back under $58.3–58.4 (Nov 4 close, Apr 9 low), now resistance, after the $60.65 high briefly cleared the $60–60.2 highs. Resistance is $58.3–58.4, then $60–60.7 (Nov 4, 9 and 10 highs) and $62.6 (Nov 3 high). Support is $56.8–57.3 (5-day, Nov 4 and Nov 10 lows), then $54.6–54.8 and $51.5 (Nov 5 low). A close above $60.7 would target $62.6; below $56.8, $54.6.

r.en: Nov 9 high $60.03; Nov 4 high $60.2; Nov 10 high $60.65
